brand.title: Brand
brand.subtitle: Your name, logo, and accent colour — used across the admin panel, the browser tab/favicon, the login screen, and form-submission emails.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Applies everywhere this install shows your brand.
identity.name: Brand name
identity.logoHelp: Square images work best. Shown in the sidebar, login page, favicon, and emails.
identity.previewHelp: How the sidebar header will look.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Optional. Recolour primary buttons and input fields across the admin panel. Leave blank to use the default theme.
theme.buttonHelp: Primary buttons. Text colour auto-adjusts for contrast.

confirm.title: Save brand changes?
confirm.description: This updates your brand and theme everywhere — the admin sidebar, browser tab & favicon, the login screen, and form-submission emails — for all users.

toasts.accentInvalid: Enter a valid accent hex colour, e.g. {example}
toasts.buttonInvalid: Button colour must be a valid hex (or empty)
toasts.inputInvalid: Input colour must be a valid hex (or empty)

languages.title: Languages
languages.subtitle: The languages editors can write content in. Each entry can have one translation per language; the default language is used when an API request doesn't ask for one, and as the fallback with .

enabled.title: Enabled languages
enabled.description: Removing a language keeps its entries; it just stops being offered in the editor.
enabled.removeWithEntries: {count, plural, one {# entry stays} other {# entries stay}}, but the language is no longer offered
enabled.orphaned: Entries exist in languages that aren't enabled:

add.title: Add a language
add.description: Use a language code such as fr, pt-BR or zh-Hant.

server.title: Email & storage
server.subtitle: Where emails are sent from and where uploaded files are kept.
server.keepSecret: Saved — leave blank to keep it.
server.envNotice: Set by {what} environment variables on the server — change it there.

mail.title: Email
mail.description: Used for password resets, team invitations and form notifications.
mail.fromHint: Shown as the sender, e.g. Acme '<'noreply@acme.com'>'. Defaults to the username.
mail.testFailed: The test email couldn't be sent
mail.saved: Email settings saved — in use now

storage.title: File storage
storage.localHint: Fine for a single server with a persistent disk.
storage.localProductionWarning: On most hosts and containers this disk is wiped on redeploy — uploads would be lost. Use S3-compatible storage.
storage.publicUrlHint: Your CDN or custom domain for the bucket. The bucket must allow public reads.
storage.testOk: Connected — a test file was written and deleted
storage.restartRequired: Storage changes take effect after the server restarts. Existing files aren't moved.
storage.restarting: Restarting — the admin will reconnect in a moment

search.title: Search
search.postgres: Searches use the database's full-text index (?search=). For typo-tolerant ranked search, run Meilisearch and set SEARCH_DRIVER=meilisearch.
search.meilisearch: Searches use Meilisearch (index “{index}”). It updates as content changes.
search.reindexQueued: Rebuilding the search index in the background
